newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - No fireworks after Dow's boom.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - No fireworks after Dow's boom.

text.p: Trading was extremely light and stocks remained in line with closing prices after an abbreviated trading session Thursday, dealers said.
"It's dead," a trader said of after-hours trading, which began at 1300 EDT on Thursday, ahead of the Independence Day three-day weekend.

However, in regular-hours trading the Dow Jones Industrial Average shot up more than 100 points to an unofficial record close of 7896, fueled by an unemployment report that suggested the economy is slowing.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume dropped to 24,200 from 173,500 on Wednesday. Session two volume was 4.6 million from 1.3 million the previous day.
